purpose: Name shared actor-template records used by the mid-ROM level-event and interaction dispatch blocks.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_46_SHARED_SPAWN
templates.post_initialize: The three producers publish their own coordinates; the level-event path derives position from the active level origin and adds (0x0140,0x0100), while the interaction paths use their caller-provided positions and may replace the animation root.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_5A_LEVEL_OBJECT
templates.post_initialize: The 0x001B74B2 and 0x001B74C4 consumers change the initialized runtime type to 0x5C and 0x5D, respectively.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_55_INTERACTION_7B_7E
templates.post_initialize: The four consumers apply x offset +8 and y offsets 0, +4, +8, and +0x0C after successful allocation.

conclusion: All three records are exact 20-byte templates selected by complete static spawn bodies. The type-0x46 record is shared across level-event and interaction producers; the type-0x5A and type-0x55 records are bounded by their dispatch entries and post-spawn mutations. Nearby records without equally complete consumers remain unresolved.
